description: This file defines the AddError class, a Java class implementing a method operation for the Apache OFBiz MiniLang framework. It provides functionality for the `<add-error>` XML element, allowing errors to be added to a list within the method context during mini-language execution.

classes.name: AddError
classes.description: Implements the `<add-error>` element as a method operation that adds a message to a list of errors within the method execution context.

classes.name: AddErrorFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of AddError, representing the `<add-error>` element.

methods.name: AddError
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the AddError object based on XML element attributes and child elements, with validation if enabled.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the operation to add a message to the error list in the current method context.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the AddError element, including attributes and nested message element if present.

methods.name: createMethodOperation
methods.description: Factory method that creates and returns an instance of AddError based on XML element and method context.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the string identifier for the `<add-error>` element.
